title: Shield of Scorching Reprisal
summary: +2 AC, Fire resistance and a retaliation against melee misses.

fields.Shield Bash: When hit by a melee attack, spend a Reaction. The attacker makes a Strength save against your spell save DC or falls Prone for 1 turn. The tooltip instead names Dexterity.
fields.Blazing Retaliation: Self Bonus Action once per Short Rest. +1 AC for 4 turns. Melee attackers who miss can take 1d6 Fire. Persists after unequipping.
fields.Acquisition: Buried corpse east of the Open Graves. DC 18 Perception or ask Marcus Falgor via Speak with Dead. Uncover with Strength 15.
